paragraphs.text: Open chat.deepseek.com in a standalone Chrome app window from a DSH sidebar button.
# dsh-open-deepseek-web
A sidebar button for the DSH Web UI that opens `chat.deepseek.com` in a standalone Chrome app window
— and, when that window is already open, brings it back to the front instead of opening a second on
and, when that window is already open, brings it back to the front instead of opening a second one.
DSH 侧边栏的一个「网页版」按钮：点一下用 Chrome 应用窗口打开 `chat.deepseek.com`；已经开着，就把那个窗口还原并置顶，不重开、不刷新。
## What it does / 它做什么
- **Focus instead of relaunch / 聚焦而不是重开** — the host half enumerates visible top-level windows and l
ooks for a title containing `deepseek` but not `Harness`. A match is restored and raised; no match f

alls through to a launch.
- **Chrome app mode / 应用窗口** — launches `chrome --app=https://chat.deepsee
k.com`, which reuses the default Chrome profile, so the DeepSeek account is the one already signed i

n in your browser.
- **Back to the conversation / 点完就回** — the main-panel component asks the host to
launch and immediately selects the conversation panel, so the click does not leave you on an empty

page.
- **Bilingual label / 中英双语** — the sidebar label follows the DSH UI language (`网页版` / `Web Cha

t`).
- **No dependencies / 零依赖** — nothing is imported from the DSH SDK; the host half spawns one Po
dencies / 零依赖** — nothing is imported from the DSH SDK; the host half spawns one PowerShell process.
## Requirements / 运行要求

- **Windows** — the host half uses PowerShell and `user32.dll` window enumeration.
- **Google Chrome
** — checked at `%ProgramFiles%`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%`, then `chrome.exe` on `PATH`. Without Chrome the
URL is handed to the default browser instead (the focus step still works).
## Install / 安装
From npm / 从 npm：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From GitHub / 从 GitHub：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH (or let the profile recompose), then reload the page. The whale button sits in the sideb
ar panel list, below the automation tasks.
重启 DSH 后刷新页面，侧边栏的上方面板列表中会多出一个鲸鱼按钮。
## Usage / 使用
Click the whale button. The first click opens the window; later clicks focus it.
## How it works / 实现
| Half | File | What it does |
| Host | `index.js` | Registers `POST /open-deepseek-web/launch` on the host web server and runs a b

ase64-encoded PowerShell snippet that focuses or launches the window. |
| Client | `client.js` | Reg
isters the whale icon in the `sidebar.panellist` slot and a `main` panel whose mount requests the la
unch and switches back to the conversation. |
The PowerShell snippet looks for a visible window whose title matches `deepseek` and does not match
`Harness` — that second clause is there so the DSH window itself is never picked.
## Known limitations / 已知限制

- **Windows only.** macOS and Linux hosts have no path through the host half.
- **Title-based matchi
ng.** A window is recognised by its title; rename the DeepSeek window's title (or run it in a langua

ge/frame that hides it) and the plugin opens a new window instead of focusing the old one.
- **Any w

indow titled with "deepseek" can match** — another app with such a title may be focused first.
- **N

o settings page.** The Chrome path list and the title pattern are constants in `index.js`.
- **The l
aunch route carries no token.** It starts a process and returns the action it took; it reads and wri
tes no files. As with any host route, a same-origin page could call it.
